query: Which BCTs and delivery modes best prompt tobacco/vaping cessation in rural emerging adults and how quickly should we expect biomarker signals (cotinine) to appear?

response.query: Which BCTs and delivery modes best prompt tobacco/vaping cessation in rural emerging adults and how quickly should we expect biomarker signals (cotinine) to appear?
response.answer: Behavioral counseling and digital interventions best prompt tobacco/vaping cessation in rural emerging adults; biomarker signals (cotinine) typically appear within 24 hours of cessation.
